id: 32_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the red spot position for the welding he
title: 激光焊机：校准焊接头的红光定位点
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/32_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the red spot position for the welding he.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/32_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the red spot position for the welding he/src.py

points.K1: 红点偏离焊丝左右时校准
points.K3: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝
points.K4: 切割嘴光打内壁，先调左右
points.K5: 仍不行：偏移归零再调上下
points.K6: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指着焊嘴下方的一个小红点
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a small red dot on the work surface below a welding gun nozzle.
shots.narration: 这一课讲焊枪红色定位点的校准。
overlay: 激光焊接机红色定位点的校准

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 两个图标：左右箭头、上下箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a left-right arrow and an up-down arrow around a red dot. No people.
shots.narration: 分左右偏移和上下偏移两种。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰对准焊缝，发现红点偏在焊丝一边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student aims the welding gun at a seam and notices the red dot falls to one side of the wire.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，红点没落在焊丝上。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰换了几个角度，红点还是偏
shots.prompt_en: He tilts the gun at different angles, but the red dot is still off to the side.
shots.narration: 怎么摆焊枪，红点都偏在一边。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李走过来，看了看焊枪头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over and looks closely at the welding gun head.
shots.narration: 老李说：这要校准红点位置。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先调左右，再调上下。

shots.section_title: 红点偏离焊丝左右时校准
shots.scene: 焊嘴下，红点偏在焊丝的一侧
shots.prompt_en: Close view: below the nozzle the red dot falls to one side of the welding wire tip. No people.
shots.narration: 喷嘴装好了，红点仍偏在焊丝左边或右边，
overlay: 红点偏离焊丝左右时校准

shots.section_title: 红点偏离焊丝左右时校准
shots.scene: 原装焊接嘴特写，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the original welding nozzle properly fitted, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 用的是原装焊接嘴，就做左右校准。

shots.section_title: 进入管理员设置
shots.scene: 老李在屏幕上依次点开设置菜单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps through blank menu items on the touch screen: settings, machine settings, administrator.
shots.narration: 在屏幕上进入系统设置、机器设置，

shots.section_title: 进入管理员设置
shots.scene: 密码键盘，输入的数字显示为圆点
shots.prompt_en: A numeric keypad on the touch screen with the entered digits shown only as dots. No people.
shots.narration: 再进管理员设置，输入管理员密码。

shots.section_title: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝
shots.scene: 老李点红点偏移右边的开始按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps the start button next to the red dot offset item on the settings page.
shots.narration: 点红点偏移旁边的开始，
overlay: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝

shots.section_title: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝
shots.scene: 分屏：点左箭头红点左移，点右箭头红点右移
shots.prompt_en: Split view: tapping a left arrow moves the red dot left, tapping a right arrow moves it right. No people.
shots.narration: 左箭头红点左移，右箭头红点右移。

shots.section_title: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝
shots.scene: 红点中心正好落在焊丝上，老李点完成
shots.prompt_en: The red dot center lands exactly on the wire; the facility engineer taps a completed button.
shots.narration: 红点中心落在焊丝上，点完成。

shots.section_title: 切割嘴光打内壁，先调左右
shots.scene: 切割嘴剖面：光束打在喷嘴内壁上
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of a narrow cutting nozzle: the beam strikes the inner wall instead of passing through the center. No people.
shots.narration: 用切割嘴时，光可能打到喷嘴内壁，
overlay: 切割嘴光打内壁，先调左右

shots.section_title: 切割嘴光打内壁，先调左右
shots.scene: 内壁处出现堵塞和反射的小图标
shots.prompt_en: Small icons of a blockage and a reflected arrow appear at the nozzle's inner wall. No people.
shots.narration: 造成堵塞或反射，先做左右校准。

shots.section_title: 仍不行：偏移归零再调上下
shots.scene: 屏幕上偏移数值框归零
shots.prompt_en: The offset value box on the settings screen is reset to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 还是不行，就把红点偏移归零，
overlay: 仍不行：偏移归零再调上下

shots.section_title: 仍不行：偏移归零再调上下
shots.scene: 焊接嘴和清洗嘴的大孔径特写，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close views of a welding nozzle and a cleaning nozzle with wide openings, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再调上下；焊接嘴清洗嘴孔大，一般不用。

shots.section_title: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停
shots.scene: 老李手持焊枪，把小内六角插进焊枪上的调节孔
shots.prompt_en: Holding the welding gun in his hand, the facility engineer inserts a small hex key into an adjustment hole on the gun.
shots.narration: 内六角插进焊枪上的孔一或孔二，
overlay: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停

shots.section_title: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停
shots.scene: 分屏：一边慢慢拧，一边散乱的红光逐渐汇成一点
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a hex key turns slowly while a scattered red glow gradually gathers into one dot. No people.
shots.narration: 一边慢慢拧，一边看喷嘴射出的红光。

shots.section_title: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停
shots.scene: 一个清晰的圆形红点，老李停手
shots.prompt_en: A sharp round red dot appears on the bench and the facility engineer stops turning.
shots.narration: 出现清晰的红点，就停。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with icons behind: a settings gear, a left-right arrow, a nozzle and a hex key.
shots.narration: 红点偏左右，进管理员设置调偏移。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 切割嘴还不行，归零后用内六角调上下。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 红点正好落在焊丝尖上
shots.prompt_en: Close view: the red dot sits exactly on the tip of the welding wire. No people.
shots.narration: 红点对准焊丝，清晰就好。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 红点校准好了，下次见！
